repos_data.description: Full-featured Golang SDK for BingX cryptocurrency exchange API. Supports USDT-M & Coin-M perpetual futures, spot trading, market data, WebSocket streams, account management, and copy trading. Type-safe, production-ready with HMAC-SHA256 security. Complete API coverage with idiomatic Go interfaces.

⚡ Professional Golang SDK for Bybit V5 API. Lightning-fast trading with real-time WebSocket streams, complete REST API coverage, and production-ready features. Supports spot & derivatives trading, HMAC/RSA authentication, multi-region endpoints, and advanced order types with TP/SL. Goroutine-safe, testnet-ready, zero dependencies. 🚀

Go client for OKX v5 API. 335 REST endpoints, 53 WebSocket channels. Type-safe models with generics, context support, auto-reconnect, demo trading mode. Covers trading, market data, account management, funding. Minimal dependencies (stdlib + gorilla/websocket). Thread-safe, production-ready. Go 1.21+

Zero-dependency Go client for the Coinglass API v4. Typed access to Futures, Spot, Options, ETF, and Indicator endpoints, with context support, safe concurrency, automatic retry with exponential backoff on rate limits, sentinel errors, and functional-option configuration. Built on the standard library and fully tested.

Lightweight Go SDK for Telegram Wallet Pay. Integrate crypto payments (TON, USDT, BTC, NOT) into Telegram bots effortlessly. Includes secure HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo. Zero dependencies for core client, typed error handling, and full test coverage. MIT licensed

Idiomatic Go SDK for the Bitget Unified Trading Account (UTA) API v3. Lightweight, dependency-minimal client with context.Context, typed REST models, string-based prices/quantities to avoid float rounding, plus reconnecting WebSocket with auto-resubscription. Built for safe and reliable crypto trading automation.

Unofficial Go SDK for the Glassnode Basic API. Dependency-light, idiomatic client covering 25 metric categories with typed structs, context propagation, automatic 429 retry, API key redaction, and runtime metadata discovery. Built for production dashboards and backtesting pipelines that need reliable on-chain data access.
Go SDK for the Birdeye public API — spot & historical prices, OHLCV candles, and price-volume data with typed responses, no hidden retries, and full HTTP transparency.
Every smart contract deserves intelligence, not just data. MCP server for on-chain calculated indicators (EMA, RSI, VWAP, Bollinger, volatility) via Chainlink.
